info.title: procurement-service (PLANNED, COM-007)
info.description: DESIGN CONTRACT, not current behaviour: procurement-service does not exist. Nothing here is implemented until the PR named in x-step (docs/adr/ADR-070-implementation-plan.md) lands; each slice then moves into a generated docs/api/procurement-service.openapi.json checked byte for byte. Money is a rial bigint as a string and is on no event. Times are UTC ISO 8601 with Z. Every route needs a bearer token and an Idempotency-Key on writes, except /v1/internal/, which takes an internal token in X-Internal-Token only (internalToken scheme; the gateway routes that prefix nowhere); roles come from configuration (docs/24 Q-119..Q-124), never from the route. A third organization gets 404 everywhere; AUDITOR reaches no route. Quotation content is never returned before openedAt (ADR-066). Design: ADR-070. Every quantity (demand, aggregation total, RFQ, order, receipts) is a whole number up to 2147483647 (MAX_QUANTITY, ADR-070 § 2): a JSON number, never a string. The gateway already routes demand-requests, aggregations, rfqs and purchase-orders here (ADR-070 § 10); until PR 14 sets the gateway flag on all four, the service itself requires the Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Register a need of the caller organization (roles from PROCUREMENT_DEMAND_ROLES). Joins the OPEN aggregation of (organization, productId) or opens one, under the aggregation row lock and the database clock read after it: a demand at or after closesAt never joins that window. productId is opaque and never checked against marketplace (Q-105, Q-120). Such a demand first ends the window in the same transaction, with the window-end transition and its event (READY, REFERRED or LAPSED: the demand opens the next window; EXTEND: it joins the same window moved on by as many whole lengths as make it open now, one transition). A demand that would take the total of the window it joins past 2147483647 is 422 AGGREGATION_QUANTITY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED and writes nothing (ADR-070 § 2).

201.description: The demand and the aggregation it joined

get.summary: The caller organization's demands only.
Own organization only; any other organization 404.

post.summary: SUBMITTED to WITHDRAWN only while its aggregation is OPEN and before closesAt by the database clock; after the window ends the demand set is frozen (422; the way out is cancelling the READY aggregation). Reason required. There is no edit: withdraw and submit again.

get.summary: The caller organization's aggregations (ListOpenAggregations with status=OPEN).
Own organization only. Carries the setting snapshot taken when the window opened.

post.summary: READY to CANCELLED with a reason (roles of the RFQ issuer).

get.summary: The caller organization's current setting version, or the environment defaults of Q-10 if it has none.

200.description: The setting in force for new windows

post.summary: Append a new setting version for the caller organization (roles from PROCUREMENT_AGGREGATION_SETTING_ROLES, Q-119). Applies to windows opened afterwards only.

READY aggregation to RFQ_ISSUED and a PUBLISHED RFQ in one transaction (roles from PROCUREMENT_RFQ_ISSUER_ROLES). procurementNature, criteria, invitees and quotationClosingAt are required and have no defaults. Every invitee must hold an approved GOODS_SUPPLY qualification and no open suspension now (supplier-service, fail closed: 503 when unreachable).

get.summary: Buyer side: RFQs of the caller organization. Supplier side (role SUPPLIER): RFQs the caller organization is invited to, and nothing else.
Buyer, or an invited supplier (product, total quantity, criteria, deadline; never requester identities). Anyone else 404.

post.summary: PUBLISHED to CLOSED, only at or after quotationClosingAt by the database clock. Idempotent; the sweeper runs the same command. Roles: PROCUREMENT_RFQ_ISSUER_ROLES of the buyer organization (another buyer role 403; a supplier or a third organization 404).
Any state but AWARDED to CANCELLED, with a closed reason code (including NO_QUALIFIED_QUOTATION). The aggregation stays RFQ_ISSUED (Q-121).

put.summary: Supplier side, invited organization only (role SUPPLIER). Seals the content (ADR-066) and returns the receipt. Refused at or after quotationClosingAt by the database clock; the standing is asked of supplier-service now (fail closed). Revising raises revision. The server, which seals the plaintext, refuses unitPriceMinor × quantity above 2^63 − 1 with 422 QUOTATION_AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE before sealing (ADR-070 § 4); the order issue keeps the same check as a backstop.

get.summary: Receipt, status and revision of the caller organization quotation. Content only after opening (ADR-066 § 4). Every read is logged.

post.summary: Before the deadline only.

CLOSED to EVALUATING. Four eyes by default (proposal then approval by another person, Q-91 rule). Verifies the receipt chain read from audit-service; any failure refuses the whole opening and opens no key. A member of any quoting organization is refused 403 CONFLICT_OF_INTEREST.

202.description: Proposal recorded; a second person must approve

get.summary: Buyer side. Before opening: count and receipt times only, no identities. After: content of every quotation. Every read is logged (QUOTATION_ACCESSED).
After opening only: unit price and total per quotation, side by side. Price is a column, not a formula (Q-88).

post.summary: Qualification decision or an append-only score revision, while EVALUATING (ADR-067 § 2).
EVALUATING to EVALUATED when every QUALIFIED quotation is fully scored; freezes the matrix. QUOTATIONS_EVALUATED carries no score.

get.summary: Integer matrix, ranks with ties, ready and readinessBlockedBy.

post.summary: Approval policy for procurement.purchase_order (ADR-063 § 2; author rule Q-70 (7); DRAFT to PENDING_PLATFORM_APPROVAL to ACTIVE with SYSTEM_ADMIN four eyes). No authority or threshold lives in code (Q-122).

get.summary: The policies governing, or written by, the organization the request acts for (contract-service GET /v1/contract-approval-policies).
The platform administrator's queue: every organization's policies awaiting approval. SYSTEM_ADMIN only.
One policy with its steps. Visible to its author organization, to the governed organization and to a platform administrator; anyone else 404.

post.summary: DRAFT to PENDING_PLATFORM_APPROVAL, by the author organization; a union author’s hierarchy is confirmed again with organization-service (fail closed).

PENDING_PLATFORM_APPROVAL to ACTIVE; retires the policy in force for the same organization in the same transaction. SYSTEM_ADMIN only; with four eyes (default on) neither the author nor the submitter (403). Requests already open keep the policy snapshot they were opened with.
PENDING_PLATFORM_APPROVAL to REJECTED with a reason (kept with the policy, never on the event). SYSTEM_ADMIN only.

ACTIVE to RETIRED with no replacement, by the author organization or a platform administrator. From then on an order is 422 APPROVAL_POLICY_REQUIRED (no policy never means approved); a request already open keeps its snapshot.

Select one QUALIFIED quotation for the whole quantity and issue the order. 422 APPROVAL_POLICY_REQUIRED without an active policy (fail closed). With one: 202 and an approval request bound to the RFQ version, quotation, rank, justification, matrix digest and amount; once approved, the same command executes in one transaction (RFQ AWARDED, order ISSUED, PURCHASE_ORDER_ISSUED without amount). 409 APPROVAL_STALE if anything changed. The winner standing is asked of supplier-service now (422 WINNER_NOT_ELIGIBLE, 503). Every remote read happens before the transaction (ADR-070 § 6): the winner standing (supplier-service), the caller membership (identity-service) and the RFQ receipt chain (audit-service); under the RFQ lock the RFQ version and the winner receipt are compared with what was read, 409 PURCHASE_ORDER_INPUT_CHANGED if either moved. The decision that executes an approved request follows the same order.

get.summary: The buyer side: an RFQ’s approval requests, newest first, by status and steps only (no binding). Another organization’s RFQ is 404.
The step authority’s inbox: requests with a step addressed to the organization the request acts for and to one of the caller’s roles there (PENDING by default).

One request. A step authority (unscoped, predicate on the step) reads it with its binding — the RFQ, quotation, supplier, rank, justification, matrix digest, quantity, unit price and amount — under the same conflict-of-interest rules as the decision (403 CONFLICT_OF_INTEREST, audited; identity-service unable to answer: UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE or UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT, nothing shown); the buyer’s order readers see status and steps only; anyone else, SYSTEM_ADMIN and AUDITOR included, 404.

post.summary: Grant or reject one PENDING step. Only a caller acting for the step’s authorityOrganizationId and holding its role there (possibly another organization than the buyer: an unscoped read whose predicate is the step) decides; anyone else 404. The requester never approves their own request (compareActors); approvers fall under the selection conflict-of-interest rules, asked of identity-service now (fail closed). The last grant executes the order with every remote read before the transaction (ADR-070 § 6).

get.summary: Buyer side: own organization. Supplier side: orders where the caller organization is the supplier.
Buyer or supplier of the order; anyone else 404.
State a purchase order as its owner records it, for a future financial consumer (internal)
get.description: The A-13 owner read (ADR-061 § 4), on the pattern contract-service's GET /v1/internal/statements/{id} set (ADR-068 PR 6a notes). Reserved for economic-service's service token, sent in X-Internal-Token with no Authorization header and signed for the buyer, the order's own organization (ADR-035); every other service and every user token is 403 (a service-side caller check, since AuthGuard admits any authenticated user), and so is a token signed for no organization (SERVICE_TENANT_CONTEXT_INVALID). An order of any other organization (the supplier's included) answers this service's own 404, exactly as one that does not exist. Returns the stored row, whatever its status; the reader builds any effect from this answer, never from PURCHASE_ORDER_ISSUED or GOODS_RECEIVED (which carry no amount), and decides itself which statuses it accepts (Q-124). Nothing is written, audited or published. No consumer exists yet (Q-123, Q-124); inventory-service joins the caller list only in the slice that builds its consumer (ADR-056 § 7).

401.description: No credentials, or a token that is expired, unverifiable or issued for another audience.

403.description: Authenticated, but not the service this route answers: any user token (whatever its roles), another service's internal token, or an internal token signed for no organization.

404.description: Not found, also returned for an order of any organization but the one the internal token is signed for (the buyer's), so its existence is never disclosed.

post.summary: Buyer side (PROCUREMENT_RECEIPT_ROLES). Cumulative received quantity never exceeds the ordered quantity (422). Moves no stock and no money (Q-123, Q-124).
PASS or FAIL with a closed reason code by PROCUREMENT_QC_ROLES; the inspector is not the receiver (RECEIVER_NOT_INSPECTOR). Changes no order, stock or money state.
ISSUED to CANCELLED before any receipt, closed reason code, behind the same approval policy gate.

internalToken.name: X-Internal-Token
internalToken.description: A service's internal token (ADR-061 § 4), signed for the organization it acts for. Sent alone: a request that also carries an `Authorization` bearer token is judged on that token, as a user. Given to /v1/internal/ routes only.

NotFound.description: Not found, or not the caller's to know about (404, never 403)

Forbidden.description: The caller may see the record but not do this (FORBIDDEN, INSUFFICIENT_ROLE, CONFLICT_OF_INTEREST, …), audited

Conflict.description: OPTIMISTIC_LOCK_FAILED, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED, APPROVAL_STALE, PURCHASE_ORDER_INPUT_CHANGED or an in-flight CONFLICT

BusinessRule.description: BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION or INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION, with a closed reason code (e.g. AGGREGATION_QUANTITY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, QUOTATION_AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE, APPROVAL_POLICY_REQUIRED, JUSTIFICATION_REQUIRED, WINNER_NOT_ELIGIBLE)

Unavailable.description: UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE or UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT: supplier-service, identity-service, audit-service or organization-service could not answer; nothing was written (fail closed)

quantity.description: Whole units of the product base unit (Q-105)

note.description: API only, never on an event

quantity.description: Whole units of the product base unit (Q-105)

totalQuantity.description: Sum of the live demands; never above MAX_QUANTITY: a demand that would take it past is 422 AGGREGATION_QUANTITY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED (ADR-070 § 2)

quotationClosingAt.description: Must be in the future by the database clock; no minimum or maximum is invented (Q-121)

totalQuantity.description: The aggregation's total, frozen at issue; the order's quantity

unitPriceMinor.description: Rial bigint as a decimal string (ADR-022)
Rial bigint as a decimal string (ADR-022)

totalMinor.description: unitPriceMinor x totalQuantity, integer, no rounding

totalScaled.description: bigint as string: sum of weightBp x scoreScaled

minAmountMinor.description: Rial bigint as a decimal string (ADR-022)

maxAmountMinor.description: Rial bigint as a decimal string (ADR-022)

authorOrganizationId.description: The governed organization or a union above it (Q-70 (7))

minAmountMinor.description: Rial bigint as a decimal string (ADR-022)

maxAmountMinor.description: Rial bigint as a decimal string (ADR-022)

rejectionReason.description: Stays with the policy; never on an event

justification.description: Required unless the choice is the untied first rank (Q-89)

ApprovalRequest.description: Who sees what (ADR-070 § 6): a step authority — acting for a step’s authorityOrganizationId with its role there, possibly another organization (a union) — sees the binding; the buyer’s order readers see status and steps only; anyone else 404.

binding.description: What the approval binds to. Step authority only (absent for the buyer-side list and read); changing any of it after a grant is 409 APPROVAL_STALE.

unitPriceMinor.description: Rial bigint as a decimal string (ADR-022)

amountMinor.description: Rial bigint as a decimal string (ADR-022)

quantity.description: Whole units of the product base unit (Q-105)

unitPriceMinor.description: Rial bigint as a decimal string (ADR-022)

amountMinor.description: Computed once at issue; on no event (ADR-070 § 8)

PurchaseOrderSourceFact.description: Only from the stored row (ADR-070 § 8). Payer and beneficiary are named outright so the reader never infers them; the currency is stated, never assumed (ADR-022).

receivedQuantity.description: Sum of recorded receipts; receipts change no stock or money (Q-123)

amountMinor.description: Rial bigint as a decimal string, exact to 2^63 - 1; computed once at issue; on no event

currency.description: Stated, not stored: no column holds a currency (Q-86, Q-120)

payerOrganizationId.description: The buyer, the order's own organization
